in_arabic.name: وزيرة
in_arabic.meaning: الوزيرة تعني المساعدة أو المعاونة في الأمور
in_arabic.long_meaning: الوزيرة هو اسم عربي مؤنث يعني المساعدة أو المعاونة في الأمور، وقد وردت كلمة الوزير في القرآن الكريم بمعنى المساعد أو النائب. وتستخدم هذه التسمية في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يقدم الدعم والمساعدة للآخرين.

in_urdu.name: وزیرہ
in_urdu.meaning: وزیرہ کا مطلب ہے مددگار یا معاون

in_hindi.name: वज़ीराह
in_hindi.meaning: वज़ीराह का अर्थ है सहायक या मददगार
in_hindi.long_meaning: वज़ीराह एक अरबी स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सहायक या मददगार। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है।

in_pashto.name: وزيره
in_pashto.meaning: وزيره د مرستي یا معاون معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: وزيره د عربي مؤنث نوم دی چې د مرستي یا معاون معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او د اسلامي کلتور سره تړلی دی.

data.cultural_impact: The name Wazirah holds a significant cultural impact, particularly in Islamic and Middle Eastern societies. Historically, the title "Wazir" was a highly respected position within the Islamic and Middle Eastern empires, often given to the most intelligent and wise individuals. The title holder was responsible for managing administrative affairs, advising the monarch, and implementing critical policies. The name Wazirah pays homage to this rich history of intellectual and political leadership and continues to be a source of pride and reverence within Islamic and Middle Eastern communities.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the spiritual significance of the name Wazirah is derived from the wisdom and intelligence it embodies. Muslims believe that wisdom is a divine gift from Allah, and it is a testament to the theological virtue of Hikmah (wisdom). Embracing the name Wazirah signifies a commitment to seeking learning, knowledge, and understanding of the world around us. It is a reminder to strive for wisdom in both our personal lives and in our relationships with others, as we strive to make informed decisions and choices that reflect the will of Allah. Furthermore, the name Wazirah can serve as a reminder of the great rewards that come with acquiring knowledge and wisdom, as it is highlighted in numerous Islamic Hadiths and Quranic verses. For instance, Sahih Bukhari Hadith 4:521 states, "Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Seeking knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim.' " (Sahih Bukhari, 4:521). Embracing the name Wazirah allows individuals to honor their commitment to ongoing self-improvement and spiritual growth while remaining rooted in their faith and Islamic traditions.
